# SheetJS browser build

- Package: SheetJS Community Edition
- Version: 0.20.3
- Source: `https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/xlsx.mjs`
- File: `xlsx-0.20.3.mjs`
- SHA-256: `1A0FB062EE9781B13F6687371B202AAEFC53B6CE55B530C027E01F9C087B77DB`

This unmodified, repository-controlled browser build supports offline XLSX generation after the application has loaded. XLSX-specific code is isolated in `services/exportService.js`.
